items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: I was working with him at the trumpet player. ... I used to go down there and help him teach drum lessons to the drummers

ctx.x: I don't suppose you ever saved one of those, did you? Or do you know anything?

Yeah, you see I was in Chicago with Herbert Moran. You might have heard of him, Herbert Moran. Yeah, sure. I was working with him at the trumpet player. Yeah. And he had a place down at 35th and South Park. And I used to go down there and help him teach drum lessons to the drummers, you know. And my traps, I left from there. When we left from Chicago, we went to Springfield. We stood down there, I think it was about three months and a half.
And you had one of those overhead then?
